atlas_fit.current_problem: Atlas needs understandable orchestration views and typed workflow components without creating a second authority system.
atlas_fit.future_risk: A visual workflow platform could duplicate Thread Engine, hide execution authority, or introduce source-available licensing constraints.

claims.claim: The repository documents a self-hostable visual directed-graph platform for AI agents and automations with multi-provider, RAG, observability, and node extension features.
Its production and security claims are sufficient for Atlas deployment without independent review.

excluded_classes: raw financial, legal, tax, insurance, mortgage, estate, brokerage, or account evidence

unresolved: Runtime behavior, security effectiveness, performance, and compatibility were not independently executed or benchmarked in this Mission.
